title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring zero-shot image classification accuracy disparities across racial categories using the FairFace dataset, and analyzing disproportionate misclassification rates into denigrating or crime-related categories (e.g., 'animal', 'suspicious person') across different racial groups.

Measuring classification accuracy disparities on the FairFace dataset and evaluating the distribution of assigned labels (e.g., occupational and appearance-based terms) for images of male versus female Members of Congress at varying probability thresholds.

Evaluating zero-shot classification accuracy across different age brackets using the FairFace dataset, and measuring the disproportionate misclassification of specific age groups (such as people aged 0-20) into harmful, crime-related, or non-human categories.
